description: Where Chimesail can reach you, and what each place may receive.

browser.title: This browser
browser.onBody: This browser is registered and can receive notifications.
browser.offBody: Turn them on to get decisions and updates in this browser.
browser.deniedBody: This browser isn’t allowing notifications from Chimesail. Allow them in the browser’s site settings, then check again.
browser.unsupportedBody: This browser can’t receive push notifications. On iPhone, open Chimesail from the Home Screen instead of a Safari tab.
browser.updateHelp: A newer version of Chimesail is available. Update to keep notifications reliable.
browser.statusUnavailable: Couldn’t read this browser’s notification state.
browser.asking: Waiting for your answer in the browser…
browser.confirmBody: Chimesail will ask this browser for permission, then register it. A registered browser can show every kind of notification, including sensitive and critical ones; you can change that from its device page afterwards.

result.registered: Notifications are on for this browser.
result.registeredNoSubscription: Registered with Chimesail, but this browser reports no active push subscription. Reload the app and check again.
result.unsupported: This browser can’t receive push notifications.
result.denied: The browser blocked notifications. Allow them in site settings, then check again.
result.dismissed: No permission was given, so nothing was registered.
result.noKey: Chimesail has no push key to register with. Nothing was registered.
result.unconfirmed: Couldn’t confirm the registration. Check again in a moment.
result.failed: This browser wasn’t registered. Nothing was changed.

devices.title: Devices
devices.emptyDetail: You can still answer decisions here. Turn on notifications in this browser to get them as they arrive.
devices.loadFailedDetail: This isn’t an empty list, and nothing was removed.
devices.stale: Couldn’t refresh devices. Showing what loaded earlier.
devices.removedUncertain: {{name}} was removed. The response was unclear, but the device list no longer shows it.

device.title: Device
device.addressesFailedDetail: Destinations and content settings are hidden until they load. Nothing was changed.
device.removeBody: Chimesail will stop sending to it. Browser permission and notifications already delivered are not affected.
device.confirmBody: Chimesail will stop sending to this device. You can register it again later.
device.removeFailedDetail: The device is still in your list. Try again.

channel.description: Where notifications go on this channel, and what they may contain.
channel.notEditableDetail: There’s no saved setting to change for this channel.
channel.invalidEmailKept: Enter a valid email address. The saved address stays as it is until you do.
channel.fullContentHelp: Content at a level you leave unticked isn’t sent here in full.

hints.private: The usual level for your own activity.
hints.sensitive: Details you’d rather not have on a lock screen.

channel.pickOne: Choose at least one. An empty choice would be treated as Public.
channel.widenEmail: Sensitive and critical details will leave Chimesail and arrive in email.
channel.widenPush: Sensitive and critical details may appear in notifications on this browser.
channel.confirmEmail: {{address}} will be able to receive {{labels}} content in full.
channel.confirmPush: Notifications on this browser will be able to show {{labels}} content in full.
channel.savedUncertain: {{channel}} settings saved. The response was unclear, but a fresh read confirms them.

conflict.title: Another address is already saved
conflict.body: This device already has an email address, and it wasn’t changed. Open it from the device page to edit it.

uncertain.title: Couldn’t confirm the save
uncertain.body: The response was unclear and the latest read doesn’t show these details. Your changes are still here; trying again is safe.

unconfirmed.title: The save didn’t take
unconfirmed.body: The latest read doesn’t show these details. Your changes are still here.

unreadable.title: Couldn’t confirm the save
unreadable.body: Chimesail couldn’t read the settings back. Your changes are still here; check your connection and try again.

deviceApps.title: Apps on your devices
deviceApps.explanation: A scenario’s own app can show its notifications on a device instead of Chimesail. Turn that on from the scenario’s app, in its notification settings. Each device still gets every notification once.
deviceApps.empty: No device has notifications turned on yet.
deviceApps.removed: {{app}} notifications on {{device}} now arrive in Chimesail.
deviceApps.removeError: {{app}} could not be switched back. Try again.
deviceApps.confirmBody: {{app}} will stop showing notifications on this device. To switch back, turn them on again in {{app}}’s own notification settings.
